title: Fubini over left cosets: θ-null set when almost every coset fibre is θ′-null (Step 6)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and let 𝓛 := ℝᴺ →L[ℝ] ℝᴺ carry the Borel σ-algebra of its operator-norm topology, with multiplication given by composition. Let θ be a finite Borel measure and θ′ a Borel probability measure on 𝓛 such that, for θ′-a.e. k ∈ 𝓛, the image of θ under g ↦ gk equals θ. Let B ⊆ 𝓛 be a Borel set with θ′({g ∈ 𝓛 : hg ∈ B}) = 0 for θ-a.e. h ∈ 𝓛. Then θ(B) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (θ θ' : Measure (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N)), IsFiniteMeasure θ → IsProbabilityMeasure θ' → (∀ᵐ k ∂θ', Measure.map (fun g ↦ g * k) θ = θ) → ∀ B : Set (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), MeasurableSet B → (∀ᵐ h ∂θ, θ' {g | h * g ∈ B} = 0) → θ B = 0
